summary: Frontend-only retest of the DayTravelNotes top-up fix. EVERY active itinerary day on fez_tanger/programa_6n_7d now renders a day-travel-notes block with exactly 3 post-it cards (covered ft67-d1..d7, including arrival d1 and return d6/d7 that previously rendered nothing). Regressions on marrakech_ergchebbi (full culture, 3 culture-derived notes per day, NO tip top-up) and atlas_desierto (bespoke day-1 notes preserved) both still hold. CMS Textos toggle still works on fez_tanger (63 contenteditable=true editable slots, derived note slots editable). Zero JS console errors on full scroll of any of the 3 pages.

issues: Theme detection picks 'mountain' for this day (probably because the day body mentions valle/atlas/montaña terms, and detectTheme() in dayTravelNotes.js evaluates mountain before city). Result: a 'Miradores del Atlas' top-up tip appears on a Roman-ruins/imperial-cities day. Not desert-themed (so satisfies the strict acceptance bullet), but city-themed would feel more on-brand for a north-Morocco cultural day. Cheap fix: reorder detectTheme to test 'city' before 'mountain', or exclude generic 'valle'/'valley' keywords from the mountain bucket.

Taglines rotate among NO TE LO PIERDAS / CULTURA LOCAL / CONSEJO DEL DÍA / PARA LA FOTO / PREPARA TU EQUIPAJE / CLIMA Y RITMO as expected. 0 console errors.

Other days unchanged from previous iterations. 0 console errors.
validated_behaviour.theme_relevance_fez_tanger: All topped-up tips on fez_tanger are city/coast/general — NO desert-themed tips appear (no 'Noche en el bivouac', 'Sol, viento y arena', 'Luz dorada y estrellas'). Bullet 4 of acceptance criteria SATISFIED.
validated_behaviour.no_console_errors: Zero JS errors and zero page errors across full top-to-bottom scroll on all 3 pages.
validated_behaviour.cms_textos_toggle_fez_tanger: [data-testid='header-text-edit-toggle'] click activates edit mode (footer banner 'MODO TEXTOS · NAVEGACIÓN BLOQUEADA' appears). On full-scroll, 63 elements with [data-testid^='editable-text-program.tourFezTanger67.'] exist, ALL with contenteditable=true. 21 of them are note-title slots, matching the expected 7 days × 3 notes. Specifically confirmed: editable-text-program.tourFezTanger67.day.1.note.0.title (text 'Llegada a Fez', contenteditable=true) and editable-text-program.tourFezTanger67.day.1.note.1.title (text 'En la medina' — a topped-up tip — also contenteditable=true). No edits were saved.

action_items: (Optional polish) In /app/frontend/src/lib/dayTravelNotes.js detectTheme(): consider testing the 'city' regex BEFORE 'mountain' (or excluding generic 'valle'/'valley' from mountain). Reason: fez_tanger d3 (Volubilis · Moulay Idriss · Meknès) currently gets the mountain 'Miradores del Atlas' tip instead of a city/medina tip, because day text mentions valleys/atlas. Acceptance test still passes (not desert), but city tips would feel more on-brand for a north-Morocco Roman-ruins day.
critical_code_review_comments: deriveDayNotes top-up logic in dayTravelNotes.js is clean: it correctly falls back to day.title/body when culture is empty (so previously-blank arrival/return days now render note 0 from the day itself), then rotates THEME_TIPS by (dayIndex-1) to avoid consecutive-day repetition, and dedupes by title.es so a culture-derived note won't be repeated as a tip.

All practical tips remain registered under the same per-route+day+note slot keys (editable-text-program.<routeId>.day.<n>.note.<i>.{tagline|title|body}) so the CMS still edits each note independently — verified on fez_tanger: derived AND topped-up notes are both editable.

Theme detection regex orders desert→coast→mountain→city — the only side-effect of this order is that days mixing imperial-city + valley terminology fall into 'mountain'. Not a bug per acceptance, just slightly off-brand for north-Morocco cultural days (see action_items).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-day post-it top-up to 3 cards is fully working across all 3 trips and trilingual switching/carousel/CMS edit-mode for derived notes were re-confirmed in this iteration and prior (35/38). The only remaining nit is the mountain-vs-city theme priority in detectTheme (see action_items + design_issues). The Chatbase floating widget still auto-opens near scroll-bottom and can intercept clicks in the bottom-right area; in this run we hid it via JS (iframe display:none + chatbase ids/classes display:none) before scrolling and that worked reliably.
